subject: Sprint extension structuring - Nova Systems PoC
messages:
From: Ben Liu <ben.liu@novasys.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: small extension for PoC (running behind)

Hi Mateo / Kimberly,

Quick note — our engineering team hit a dependency from a third-party API and we need a little more runway to complete the performance tests you requested. Can we extend the current 30-day pilot by 3 weeks (21 days)? The delay is internal only; we expect to finish the remaining tests within that window.

Two asks from our side: 1) pricing for a 21-day extension (pro-rated vs. flat add-on), and 2) whether Redwood can convert any unused trial credits into a scoped "Sprint Accelerator" credit (applied only to this PoC) instead of a refund. Attached is our latest burn + test schedule.

Attachment: pilot-burn-report.csv (CSV, 42KB)

Thanks — Ben
Ben Liu
Head of ML Infrastructure, Nova Systems
ben.liu@novasys.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: Ben Liu <ben.liu@novasys.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: small extension for PoC (running behind)

Hi Ben — thanks for the heads up, and glad to hear the delay is internal. We can accommodate a short extension, and there are two reasonable ways to structure this depending on how you want accounting to see it:

Option A — Pro-rated time extension (no structural change):
- 21-day run extension added to the existing PoC.
- Pro-rated rate: $380/day (hosted API credits) -> $7,980 total for 21 days.
- Unused credits remain on the same account, expire at the PoC end.

Option B — Sprint Accelerator add-on (recommended if you want protected runway + dedicated priority):
- 21-day Sprint Accelerator bundle: $6,400 (20% discount vs. equivalent token spend), includes priority queueing and a dedicated support buffer (up to 6 engineering hours).
- We can convert up to 20% of your remaining trial credits into this Sprint Accelerator credit to offset the invoice; remaining balance billed.

I'll loop in Kimberly to confirm discounts/finance flow and Marissa to prepare a short addendum. I attached a quick draft addendum and a proposed milestone schedule you can review.

Attachments: PoC_Milestone_Schedule.pdf, redwood-addendum-draft.docx

If you prefer, I can send a DocuSign once we agree which option you want. Which path makes procurement easiest for Nova?

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Account Exec — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, Ben Liu <ben.liu@novasys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: small extension for PoC (running behind)

Looping in Finance/Legal posture so procurement has clarity. Mateo — 

We can approve Option B (Sprint Accelerator) with the conversion mechanic, subject to:
- Cap conversion to 20% of remaining trial credit USD value (to avoid credit arbitrage).
- Accelerator price set at $6,400 for 21 days (as proposed) and billed net-30 unless Nova requests PO-based invoicing.
- Include 6 hours of engineering support and priority queueing.

Ben — can you confirm the remaining trial-credit USD amount (rough number is fine) so we can calculate the conversion amount? Also confirm whether your procurement requires a PO number or DocuSign is acceptable. If PO is needed, we will route to billing for PO-based invoice.

Marissa — please prepare the addendum with the conversion clause and a short schedule of deliverables.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: Ben Liu <ben.liu@novasys.com>, contracts@novasys.com <contracts@novasys.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: small extension for PoC (running behind)

Ben — appreciate the quick replies. Per Kimberly and internal approvals, here's what we can confirm today: 

Agreement summary:
- Term: 21-day extension to the existing PoC, new end date = original end date + 21 days.
- Commercial: Sprint Accelerator add-on at $6,400.
- Credit conversion: Redwood will convert 20% of your remaining trial-credit USD value to the Sprint Accelerator credit. Example: if remaining credits = $4,000, conversion covers $800 and Nova pays the $5,600 balance.
- Support: includes up to 6 engineering hours for integration help and priority scheduling.
- Billing: DocuSign addendum preferred; alternatively we can invoice on receipt of PO.

Next steps:
1) Ben: confirm remaining trial-credit USD (ballpark figure is fine) and whether DocuSign is acceptable or you need a PO.
2) Marissa: will send the addendum and a pre-filled DocuSign link for signature (see placeholder link below).
3) Once signed, we will apply the converted credit to your account and provision the Sprint Accelerator immediately.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.net/prepare/ABC-EXT-2026
HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2026-311

Attachment references repeated: PoC_Milestone_Schedule.pdf, redwood-addendum-draft.docx, pilot-burn-report.csv

Thanks — looking forward to getting you the extra runway.

Best,
Mateo
